relationships.evidence_quote: In the DRG, we also observed a significant increase in Monocyte Chemoattractant Protein-1 (MCP-1/CCL2) (P = 0.0031, MD = 19.24, 95% CI [31.63-6.848]), a chemokine involved in chronic pain mechanisms, which was also reduced by pVNS treatment

key_findings: Weekly pVNS resolved chronic bilateral mechanical allodynia after tibial fracture surgery in male and female mice, improved bone healing and rotarod performance.
pVNS reduced surgery-induced GFAP and CCL2 in DRG satellite cells, which were colocalized.
